exposure: number of arterial and venous blood draws
cohort: The participants were 892 preterm infants admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) at Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University between January 2020 and December 2023.
finding: A nurse-led predictive nomogram model, incorporating six clinical variables, was developed and internally validated, showing good predictive ability (AUC 0.953) for nosocomial infections in preterm infants.
